QuestInfo.name: [Korean Folk Town] Moni Remembers
QuestInfo.0: Moni's memories of when she was the Nine-Tailed Fox all came back to her.\r\n
QuestInfo.1: Moni's memories of when she was the Nine-Tailed Fox all came back to her.\r\n
QuestInfo.2:
Moni's memories of when she was the Nine-Tailed Fox all came back to her.
Moni tried to stop the stone herself,
but the Goblin wanted to protect her and jumped off the cliff.
He perished at Goblin Hill, and Moni wept for him.
QuestInfo.summary: Retrieve the Stone of Jealousy and save Korean Folk Town from danger.
